svg.text: GHOSTED: Auntie Dot, explore (Illustrator, 2026-11-26)
Illustrator Phase 1-2: local references, 10 rough thumbnails, 3 directions, one pick. Hand-drawn Bezier half outlines lifted to round bodies (Ricky sketch library); palette rows only.
REFERENCES (local only, the locked family; no web)
Kit v5 (hero)
Ricky v1
Ghostie v7
ATS-9000 v1
ATS v1 lineup at the game camera (x2): the family on grass
THUMBNAILS (10). Top: front, rough. Below: the same at the game camera (x3, 26 m, pitch 42, net yaw 5), at 0.9 x Kit.
1 pear, top-back bun, folded
2 capsule, top bun (BMGD)
3 tea cosy, nape bun, glasses
4 egg, double buns
5 box coat, top bun, glasses
6 pear, nape bun, arms out
7 pear, big head, glasses
8 capsule, small head, folded
9 tea cosy, top-back bun
10 egg, top bun, glasses
DIRECTIONS (3), developed: front, 3/4, back; then the game camera (x3): Dot left, Kit right (real v7 render)
A. COTTAGE LOAF (pick)
Big round head on a soft pear: the widest
point is the belly, so she reads short and
round, and still a toy pawn like Kit and
Ricky. Folded hands = calm, kind, listening.
Top-back bun clears the eyes and makes a
clear bump on the 64 px silhouette.
B. CAPSULE + BUN (BMGD hint)
The hint as given. At the game camera it
reads as 'a purple Kit with a bun': the
same capsule as Kit, so only colour
tells them apart. Arms out make it stiff.
C. TEA COSY
A bell to the ground, glasses, low bun.
Very 'granny', but no feet breaks the pawn
family, the nape bun hides behind the head
at pitch 42, and the glasses ring the eyes
at 1x (Ricky's fringe lesson).
